shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && git ls-files | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | grep -i -E "calendar|date|picker"

cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -80; echo ---; ls node_modules | head -80; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo ---; (timeout 25 npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -15)

timeout 110 npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@4 @gravity-ui/date-utils 2>&1 | tail -5 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/esm/components && grep -n "Calendar\b\|DatePicker\b\|^export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -30
timeout 110 npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@4 @gravity-ui/date-utils 2>&1 | grep -v "allow-scripts" | tail -20; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat package.json

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/esm/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/esm/index.d.ts && sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/esm/components/Calendar/ && grep -rn "import.*css" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.js | head && grep -n "export declare function dateTime\b\|export declare const dateTime\b\|dateTime(" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/dateTime/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json | grep -A3 '"style"\|"sideEffects"'

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components; ls $D; echo ---; grep -E '"main"|"module"|"types"|"style"|"sideEffects"' $D/package.json; echo ---; cat $D/build/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null || cat $D/build/cjs/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- calendar props"; find $D/build -path "*Calendar/Calendar.d.ts" -not -path "*cjs*" | head -1 | xargs sed -n 1,60p; echo "--- css"; find $D/build -name "*.css" -not -path "*cjs*" | head; grep -rn "import '.*css'" $(find $D/build -path "*Calendar/Calendar.js" -not -path "*cjs*") | head -3; echo "--- date-utils"; grep -rn "export.*dateTime" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/index.d.ts | head; grep -n "declare function dateTime\|declare const dateTime" -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build --include="*.d.ts" | head -3

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm; cat $D/index.d.ts; echo "--- calendar props"; sed -n 1,80p $D/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts; echo "--- calendar base props"; find $D/components/Calendar -name "*.d.ts" | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -rn "css'" $D/components/Calendar/Calendar.js | head -3; echo "--- date-utils dateTime"; sed -n 10,40p node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/dateTime/dateTime.d.ts; echo "--- README calendar"; grep -n -A25 "^## Properties\|^### Calendar\|onUpdate" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md | head -40

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm; sed -n 1,80p $D/components/CalendarView/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts; echo "--- settings"; grep -n "settings\|loadLocale\|setLocale\|getLocale" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/settings/settings.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -15; echo "--- DateTime format"; grep -n "format(\|toDate\|toISOString\|locale(" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/typings/dateTime.d.ts | head -8

rm -rf dist && git status --short && (which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; node -e "require.resolve('playwright')" 2>&1 | head -1) ; echo "browser-check-done"
